title: Choose the visual world for Simulatte Studio
question: The roll assigned Production Board. Keep it, take the pick, adopt a challenger, or re-roll. All six dealt challengers lost on both axes; each one's discipline is raised into the assigned direction.

options.label: Production Board
options.lineage: Shop-floor visual management: heijunka and kanban boards, 5S floor-marking colours
options.thesis: Results read like a production control board: KPI lanes, configuration slots, and a baseline taped to the floor.
materials: black tape rules on board white
options.viewport: Machine-green study rail; the work area is a board of KPI lanes by configuration columns, the baseline column taped yellow, each cell a finding card with its interval on the lane's shared axis and its difference against the baseline.
options.risk: Turns into a factory costume if tape and floor colours go past structure; yellow tape needs a dark edge and a text label to meet AA.

raised.raise: Every replication is a countable cell under its configuration; failed ones are struck through, never hidden or paged.
Motion snaps: no easing, state changes land in two steps over 90 ms, like a magnet seating.
One reserved ink, the floor yellow, belongs only to the researcher's own layer: baseline, pinned findings, presentation picks.
Large grids focus one factor slice at full size and keep the rest of the grid as context, never a shrunken miniature.
Values print only the digits their interval supports; full precision is an explicit, labelled toggle.
Columns never move: live results change cells in place, and reordering is always an explicit sort.

options.label: Forest Plot
options.lineage: Cochrane meta-analysis figures and clinical-trial reporting
options.thesis: Every comparison is an interval drawn against a line of no difference.
options.viewport: KPI-major blocks; inside each, configurations as rows with point and interval on one axis, a typeset estimate column, and a difference plot against the baseline's zero line.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where careful statistical interfaces usually land, near the editorial-hairline default, and colour does little work.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.lineage: doujin event circle catalogs on newsprint
options.thesis: Every replication as a stamp-sized cell in a numbered hall grid.
options.viewport: Studies as a packed numbered grid keyed to a map of the project.
options.case: Researchers and clients do not know this artifact, and a thumbnail grid hides the comparison.
options.kept: Density courage: the whole population visible at once, in whole cells.
options.risk: Reads as fandom ephemera on a statistics screen.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software reference manuals with tabbed dividers
options.thesis: Study sections as hued divider boards under clear acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail sized by extent; findings on leaves over the section hue.
options.case: Weak identification outside one generation of users; ply and hue add reading cost to dense tables.
options.kept: A strict motion grammar: two-frame steps, no easing.
options.risk: Nostalgia piece; layered leaves fight table legibility.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.lineage: ISOM orienteering maps and control descriptions
options.thesis: The study as a purple course over a fixed terrain of evidence.
options.viewport: Define, run, analyse, present as numbered controls over the results.
options.case: Its truth (the course never edits the terrain) fits immutable evidence, but a map is not clearer than a matrix for comparisons.
options.kept: A reserved ink used only for the user's own layer.
options.risk: Map metaphor stretches thin on tabular pages.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Configurations as coloured lines, studies as interchanges.
options.viewport: Study flow drawn as a line diagram on midnight blue.
options.case: Universal but not this audience's world; a dark ground suits neither the daytime desk nor the projector.
options.kept: Focus the chosen corridor without shrinking the whole network.
options.risk: Decoration on pages that are mostly numbers.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Low resolution as an honest, visible state.
options.viewport: Findings set as specimen lines at several sizes.
options.case: No identification for researchers or clients; pixel display type harms reading of figures.
options.kept: Honest resolution, translated as precision that matches the interval.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Replications as live rows flipping status.
options.viewport: Experiment progress as a departure board.
options.case: An instrument costume; fits a progress view, not results and analysis.
options.kept: Fixed columns with content changing in place.
options.risk: Novelty that wears off by the second study.

canonCard.label: Experiment tracker standard
canonCard.thesis: What experiment trackers ship (Weights & Biases, MLflow, Posit Connect), executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Header with run metadata, a configurations table with mean and CI columns, a panel grid of charts below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from neighbouring tools by design.
